messages:
Sam: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/6789 — adds smart routing fallback + kernel selection tweaks. blocked on arch review and RFC alignment: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/rfcs/2026-03-routing-fallbacks
Lia: quick skim — can you add a short summary in the PR description about backwards compatibility and safety tradeoffs? also link to the exact RFC section (3.2) please
Sam: yep will add. PR is currently gated by the rfc-required merge check, pinging @Priyanka and @Omar for arch signoff
Priyanka: I can take a look tomorrow AM (PST). initial glance looks fine but need clarity on fallback ordering and kernel selection heuristics — can you point to the lines? :thinking:
Sam: inline markers at runtime/route_manager.py ~L120-150 and runtime/kernel_selector.py. quick snippet:
```
# prefer low-latency kernel when token_len < 512
if seq_len < 512:
    select('fast_attention_v2')
```
Lia: also: do we have a compatibility test for quantized models? I remember a flake a while back. tests/quantization_compat_test.py might need updates
Omar: arch note — we should not flip defaults without a canary. add a feature flag `enable_experiment_kernel_v2` (false by default) and a canary rollout plan in the PR. also include fallback to previous kernel on error (timeout/error budget)
Sam: ok will add flag + canary plan (20% traffic for 48h). target merge Wed EOD — any objections?
Priyanka: agree with Omar. Also please add perf numbers (p50/p95 latency, throughput) vs current kernel on at least two workload profiles. a tiny table in the PR description is fine
Lia: and add a dashboard goal: kernel_mismatch_rate + error_rate for the canary window
Sam: will update tonight and ping when done @Priyanka @Omar
Priyanka: once you add perf numbers and the flag/canary plan, I can do arch signoff. right now no major infra risks visible
Bot-deploy: This PR is currently blocked by `rfc-required` gate (RFC: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/rfcs/2026-03-routing-fallbacks). To proceed, attach arch signoff in PR description or update RFC link to exact section in the PR
Sam: noted — leaving PR open until signoff. thanks all :pray:
Lia: thanks Sam. ping back when ready and I'll do a quick re-check
Sam: will do — marking blocked until changes are in place
